features.title: Zero dependencies
features.description: No runtime dependencies at all: the whole library, CSS included, is a single self-contained bundle.

features.title: Framework-agnostic
features.description: Works with plain script tags (UMD), or as an ESM/CJS import in React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, or anything else.

features.title: No build step required
features.description: Drop in a single <script> tag and call toasts.showToast(...), no bundler or compilation needed.

features.title: Fully themeable
features.description: Every color is a CSS custom property, overridable per-toast or library-wide, with automatic close-icon contrast.

features.title: Built-in localization
features.description: English, German, Spanish and French chrome text out of the box, with custom translation overrides.

features.title: Six stacking positions
features.description: Edge-agnostic stacking math keeps toasts from overlapping in any corner or center-edge position.

features.title: Multi-step & confirm buttons
features.description: Built-in confirm-before-action, copy-to-clipboard, and general multi-step button state machines.

features.title: Expandable details
features.description: Attach extra collapsible detail lines to any toast without cluttering the main message.

features.title: Progress bars
features.description: An optional thin progress bar synced to a toast's auto-dismiss countdown, fill or drain, any edge.

features.title: Promise-based toasts
features.description: toasts.promise() ties a toast to a fetch/async call's lifecycle: a loading state that patches itself to success or error once the promise settles.

features.title: TypeScript-first
features.description: Full .d.ts types ship with every build, with every option documented via JSDoc.

toastOptions.name: title
toastOptions.description: Optional bold title line above the message.

toastOptions.name: titleMode
toastOptions.description: Whether title renders on its own line above message (stacked) or as a bold lead-in sharing its line (inline). No effect when title is unset.

toastOptions.name: severity
toastOptions.description: Semantic severity - the sole driver of role/aria-live (WARNING/ERROR get role="alert", INFO/SUCCESS get role="status"). Also picks the default color (via configure()'s colors palette) when color itself isn't set.

toastOptions.name: color
toastOptions.description: Background color of the indicator bar. Purely presentational - has no effect on role/aria-live, which come from severity alone. Any CSS color string works; ToastColor just bundles presets.

toastOptions.name: duration
toastOptions.description: Auto-dismiss after this many ms. Use 0 to make the toast sticky (never auto-dismisses).

toastOptions.name: closable
toastOptions.description: Whether clicking the toast dismisses it.

toastOptions.name: allowHtml
toastOptions.description: If true, message is rendered as HTML. Sanitize the input yourself if it may contain user-controlled content.

toastOptions.name: allowLineBreaks
toastOptions.description:
Whether \n or literal
in message/title/button labels/details renders as a real line break.

toastOptions.name: position
toastOptions.description: Which screen edge/corner this toast stacks from.

toastOptions.name: animation
toastOptions.description: Entry/exit animation. slide, fade, none, or a name registered via registerToastAnimation().

toastOptions.name: onClose
toastOptions.description: Called as soon as the toast starts closing, manually or via duration timeout.

toastOptions.name: removeOtherToasts
toastOptions.description: If true, dismisses every other currently-visible toast before showing this one.

toastOptions.name: reverseOrder
toastOptions.description: If true, inserts this toast at the far end of its position's stack instead of nearest the anchor edge. Creation-time only.

toastOptions.name: pauseOnHover
toastOptions.description: Whether hovering the toast, or focusing it or anything inside it, pauses its auto-dismiss timer. No effect on sticky toasts.

toastOptions.name: progress
toastOptions.description: Adds a thin progress bar. fill/drain sync to the auto-dismiss countdown; manual is driven yourself via setToastProgress(id, value). true = all defaults.

toastOptions.name: data
toastOptions.description: Arbitrary data to associate with the toast, readable later via getToastData(id).

toastOptions.name: theme
toastOptions.description: Extra color knobs beyond color: card background, text, details block, action/close-icon colors.

toastOptions.name: transition
toastOptions.description: Only meaningful passed to updateToast (directly, or via promise()) - animates the whole toast card into the patch instead of swapping instantly. No-op at creation, since there's nothing to transition from yet.

toastOptions.name: buttons
toastOptions.description: Action buttons rendered right of the message. Clicks never trigger closable dismissal.

toastOptions.name: details
toastOptions.description: Extra lines revealed by an auto-added Details toggle, rendered outside the dismissable row.

toastOptions.name: detailsLabel
toastOptions.description: Label for the auto-added details toggle button. Set together with details.

toastOptions.name: detailsHideLabel
toastOptions.description: Label for the toggle button while details are expanded. Set together with details.

toastOptions.name: closeButton()
toastOptions.description: Ready-made button that dismisses the toast it's on.

toastOptions.name: confirmButton()
toastOptions.description: Ready-made confirm-before-action button: swaps the toast's message/color to a confirm step, then Yes/No, runs onConfirm, optionally a pending step, then a done flash that either restores the original content or closes the toast.

toastOptions.name: stepButton()
toastOptions.description: The general-purpose primitive behind detailsCopyButton(): a button that walks through custom steps in order.

configOptions.name: severity
configOptions.description: Library-wide default severity for calls that omit it - drives role/aria-live and the default color.

configOptions.name: duration
configOptions.description: Library-wide default auto-dismiss duration in ms.

configOptions.name: closable
configOptions.description: Library-wide default for whether clicking a toast dismisses it.

configOptions.name: allowHtml
configOptions.description: Library-wide default for whether message is rendered as HTML.

configOptions.name: allowLineBreaks
configOptions.description:
Library-wide default for \n/
rendering as real line breaks.

configOptions.name: titleMode
configOptions.description: Library-wide default for whether title stacks above message or shares its line.

configOptions.name: responsiveBreakpoint
configOptions.description: Below this viewport width (px), *-left/*-right positions collapse into their edge's *-center position and share one stack. Re-evaluated live on resize. Set to 0 to disable collapsing entirely.

configOptions.name: maxToasts
configOptions.description: Maximum toasts visible at once (per position, unless overridden via configurePosition()).

configOptions.name: evictOldest
configOptions.description: When maxToasts is exceeded, evict the oldest toast to make room instead of blocking new ones.

configOptions.name: pauseOnHover
configOptions.description: Library-wide default for whether hovering/focusing a toast pauses its timer.

configOptions.name: promiseTimeout
configOptions.description: Library-wide default for promise()'s timeout (ms). If a promise hasn't settled within this long, its loading toast is patched to messages.timeout instead. 0 disables the timeout.

configOptions.name: locale
configOptions.description: Force a specific bundled locale (e.g. "de"). Omit to auto-detect from the browser, falling back to "en".

configOptions.name: translations
configOptions.description: Partial string overrides layered on top of the resolved locale pack.

configOptions.name: theme
configOptions.description: Library-wide default color overrides: card background, text, details block, action/close-icon colors.

configOptions.name: colors
configOptions.description: The severity -> default color lookup: what an unset color resolves to for a given severity, and what promise() defaults color to for its timeout/success/error outcomes. Accessibility (role/aria-live) is unaffected by this - it comes from severity alone. Merges key-by-key over the current value.

ToastPositionValue.description: Which screen edge/corner a toast stacks from. All six are implemented; stacking math is edge-agnostic.

values.description: Stacks upward from the bottom-center of the screen. The default.
Stacks downward from the top-center of the screen.
Stacks downward from the top-left corner.
Stacks downward from the top-right corner.
Stacks upward from the bottom-left corner.
Stacks upward from the bottom-right corner.

ToastAnimationValue.description: Entry/exit animation. Passing an unimplemented/unregistered value falls back to slide with a one-time console warning. Custom animations can be added via registerToastAnimation().

values.description: Slides in/out from its stacking edge while fading. The default.
Opacity-only - appears already at its resting position, nothing slides.
No transition at all: appears, disappears, and reflows instantly.

ToastTransitionValue.description: How updateToast() (directly, or via promise()) animates into a visual patch. Passing an unregistered value falls back to fade with a one-time console warning. Custom transitions can be added via registerToastTransition().

values.description: Fades the toast card out, applies the patch, then fades it back in.
Applies the patch immediately and shakes the card left-right over it, to draw attention rather than hide the change.
No animation: applies instantly. Same as omitting transition entirely.

ToastColorValue.description: Convenience color presets. color/theme fields accept any CSS color string, not just these.

values.description: Default color for informational toasts.
For successful operations.
For warnings.
For errors/failures.

ToastSeverityValue.description: Semantic severity - the sole driver of a toast's role/aria-live. Independent of color: color is purely presentational and never affects accessibility semantics.

values.description: role="status"/aria-live="polite". Default color ToastColor.INFO. The default severity.
role="status"/aria-live="polite". Default color ToastColor.SUCCESS. Also promise()'s default success severity.
role="alert"/aria-live="assertive". Default color ToastColor.WARNING. Also promise()'s default timeout severity.
role="alert"/aria-live="assertive". Default color ToastColor.ERROR. Also promise()'s default error severity.

ToastTheme.description: Extra color knobs beyond color: the toast's overall chrome, not just its accent bar. Each field mirrors a --bt-* CSS custom property, so plain CSS works too.

fields.name: background
fields.description: Toast card background. CSS var --bt-background.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Toast text color. CSS var --bt-text.

fields.name: detailsBackground
fields.description: Details block background. CSS var --bt-details-background.

fields.name: actionColor
fields.description: Action button/details toggle text color. CSS var --bt-action-color.

fields.name: closeIcon
fields.description: Close (x) icon color. Auto-picked dark/light against color unless set here. CSS var --bt-close-icon.

ToastColorPalette.description: One default color string per severity (ToastSeverityValue key). Looked up when a toast's severity is known but color isn't set - never the other way around, so reskinning this never affects accessibility.

fields.name: INFO
fields.description: Default color for ToastSeverity.INFO.

fields.name: SUCCESS
fields.description: Default color for ToastSeverity.SUCCESS; also promise()'s default success color.

fields.name: WARNING
fields.description: Default color for ToastSeverity.WARNING; also promise()'s default timeout color.

fields.name: ERROR
fields.description: Default color for ToastSeverity.ERROR; also promise()'s default error color.

ToastProgressOptions.description: Configures the optional progress bar: synced to a toast's auto-dismiss countdown (fill/drain), or driven yourself (manual).

fields.name: position
fields.description: Which edge of the toast card the bar sits on.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Anchor point the bar grows from/shrinks toward. Always physical, not RTL-aware.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: fill starts empty and grows; drain starts full and shrinks; manual doesn't move on its own - call setToastProgress(id, value) yourself as real work progresses. Ignores the auto-dismiss timer entirely, so it stays visible on a sticky toast too.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Initial fill fraction (0-1) when mode: 'manual'. Ignored otherwise. Update later via setToastProgress(id, value).

fields.name: color
fields.description: Fill color.

fields.name: trackColor
fields.description: Color of the unfilled track.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Bar thickness in px.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Accessible name for the bar (role="progressbar", with aria-valuemin/max/now kept in sync), e.g. "Uploading file".

ToastButton.description: One action button rendered on a toast (or a ToastDetailItem's own buttons).

fields.name: label
fields.description:
Rendered as plain text; \n/
still honored as line breaks.

fields.name: onClick
fields.description: Receives the click event and this toast's id.

fields.name: className
fields.description: Extra class name(s) appended alongside the built-in bt-toast-action class.

ToastButtonStep.description: One step of a multi-step button's state machine (the primitive behind stepButton()/detailsCopyButton()).

fields.name: label
fields.description: Text shown while this step is active.

fields.name: onClick
fields.description: Runs on click. Return false to stay on this step instead of advancing.

fields.name: className
fields.description: Extra class(es) applied only while this step is active.

fields.name: revertAfterMs
fields.description: Auto-advance to revertToStep this many ms after becoming active. No effect on steps[0].

fields.name: revertToStep
fields.description: Step index revertAfterMs advances to.

ToastConfirmButtonOptions.description: The third argument to confirmButton()/withConfirmButton() - customizes each step of the confirm flow (confirm, pending, done).

fields.name: confirmMessage
fields.description: Message shown on the confirm step.

fields.name: confirmColor
fields.description: Toast color during the confirm step.

fields.name: yesLabel
fields.description: Confirm step's confirm button label.

fields.name: noLabel
fields.description: Confirm step's cancel button label.

fields.name: pendingMessage
fields.description: Message shown while an async onConfirm is pending, replacing the buttons entirely. Unset keeps the confirm step's content and just disables the buttons instead.

fields.name: pendingColor
fields.description: Toast color while an async onConfirm is pending.

fields.name: doneMessage
fields.description: Message flashed after onConfirm succeeds. Pass null to skip the flash entirely.

fields.name: doneColor
fields.description: Toast color during the done flash.

fields.name: doneTimeoutMs
fields.description: How long the done flash stays up before doneAction runs.

fields.name: doneAction
fields.description: What happens after the done flash (or immediately, if doneMessage is null): restore the original title/message/buttons/color, or close (dismiss) the toast.

fields.name: className
fields.description: Extra class name(s) on the button itself.

ToastDetailItem.description: One line of a toast's expandable details block. A plain string is shorthand for { value }.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Optional label shown before the value, e.g. "Status".

fields.name: value
fields.description: The detail line's text.

fields.name: buttons
fields.description: Extra action buttons rendered after this item's value, e.g. a Copy button.

examples.title: All six stacking positions
examples.description: Fires one toast per screen edge/corner, showing that the stacking math handles every position the same way.

examples.title: Confirm before acting
examples.description: Each step of the confirm flow gets its own color and message: confirm, a pending state while the (simulated) delete runs, then a success flash that closes the toast instead of reverting.
examples.code:
new ToastBuilder("Delete this file?")
  .withColor(ToastColor.WARNING)
  .withDuration(0)
  .withConfirmButton(
    "Delete",
    (event, id) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500)),
    {
      confirmMessage: "Are you sure you want to delete this file?",
      confirmColor: ToastColor.ERROR,
      pendingMessage: "Processing, it might take a while.",
      pendingColor: ToastColor.INFO,
      doneMessage: "File deleted successfully.",
      doneColor: ToastColor.SUCCESS,
      doneTimeoutMs: 2000,
      doneAction: "close",
    }
  )
  .show();

examples.title: Confirm + live progress bar
examples.description: Combines confirmButton() with progress: { mode: 'manual' } - onConfirm reports real progress via setToastProgress(id, value) instead of the bar just tracking a duration.

examples.title: Multi-step buttons
examples.description: The general-purpose state machine behind detailsCopyButton(), walking through your own custom steps.

examples.title: Expandable details
examples.description: Attach extra collapsible lines to a toast without cluttering the main message.
examples.code:
new ToastBuilder("Order shipped!")
  .withColor(ToastColor.SUCCESS)
  .withDetails(
    ["Order #1234 shipped", "Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784"],
    "Show details",
    "Hide details"
  )
  .show();

examples.title: Progress bar
examples.description: A thin progress bar synced to the toast's auto-dismiss countdown.

examples.title: Promise-based toast
examples.description: toasts.promise() shows a sticky loading toast, then patches it to a success or error message (and color) once the promise settles - no manual updateToast() bookkeeping needed. Each outcome picks its own transition: a fade on success, a shake on error.

examples.title: Play a transition on demand
examples.description: playToastTransition(id, transition) plays a transition with no content change - e.g. shaking a toast to signal a disallowed action instead of dismissing it.

examples.title: Reverse stacking order
examples.description: Insert a toast at the far end of the stack instead of nearest the anchor edge.

examples.title: Custom theme colors
examples.description: Override background, text, and action colors per toast without touching CSS.

examples.title: Sticky toast with actions
examples.description: duration: 0 keeps a toast on screen until the user acts on it, instead of auto-dismissing.

examples.title: Rich HTML content
examples.description: Opt into HTML rendering for the message when plain text isn't enough.
